style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, hard noon sun through clear shallow water
motion_rule: he holds his spot and never travels; the camera slides sideways in EVERY beat and reverses at 2.0, 3.8, 5.4 and 7.45, so crates, ropes and the quote board tear past behind him; the brokers throw their fins up and the eel hauls papers across the lens in EVERY beat; his gold scales flare and he works fins, tail and mouth in EVERY beat; he fills half the frame height; new shot size every beat; one action per beat; no push in, no rack focus
character: a plump golden carp upright on his tail, thick lips, heavy jowls, two huge gilded gill covers pumping like bellows
second_characters: A SWARM of mismatched fish in silk ties packed behind him, mouths wide, fins thrown up in every beat; ONE lean eel broker within a fin of the lens hauling blank papers every beat; two slim bright fish drifting past after 7.45
props: ONE fat gold ring in the sand; blank paper sheets the brokers wave; furry mic bottom right
prop_continuity: the papers are never his; the ring is his
environment: a noon bright shallow lagoon over a sunken market: sun shafts to the sand, crates, ropes, glass buoys, a huge quote board over the crowd with rows of numbers streaking across it in a blur

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; the numbers on the board are never spoken; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, flat and smug, even 4.4 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, no silent lead-in; 0.0-3.8 one breath, short breath at 3.8, 3.8-7.45 one breath; after 7.45 no words, only his whistle and clicks
audio.pronunciation: go-DA-mi, NO-si-te, DEN-ghi, AK-tsi-i, ZHDYO-te, CHU-da, vlo-ZHIL, ZHAB-ry, TO-ne-te
audio.lip_sync: his mouth opens on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: water surge, bubbles bursting, a trading floor roar, paper rustling, a bright two note whistle at 8.8, tongue clicks at 9.4

timeline.a: he jabs a fin at the lens as the brokers throw their fins up behind him
he sweeps both fins across the lens, the quote board tearing past above the crowd
chest-up: he flicks his tail and bubbles blast into the lens
he spreads his fins wide as the eel hauls papers through the lens
he hammers his gold gill cover with a fin, the crowd waving papers overhead
chest-up: he fans both gilded gills wide at the lens
he pumps the gills hard, a wall of bubbles rolling across the lens
he jabs a fin at the crowd as a broker fish sinks past the lens
he slaps his tail at the lens, brokers tumbling behind him
the eel dumps papers over the crowd, wiping the lens
he rolls his body at the lens, his gold scales flaring and shimmering across the frame
two slim bright fish drift past and he whistles after them, gills flaring
he clicks his tongue at the lens and slams his gill covers shut

must_appear: the first word is heard at 0.0; the shouting brokers and the quote board are behind him in every beat; at 8.15 his gold scales flare across the frame; at 8.8 he whistles after the two bright fish; at 9.4 he clicks his tongue at the lens
negative_prompt: a silent opening, a still last second, conveyor belt, cart, rail, a hero riding anything, a hero swimming at the camera head first, numbers read aloud, speech bubble, subtitles, watermark, cyrillic, latin letters, printed words on props, darkness, night, dark scene, murky water, letterbox, a horizontal frame, a parked camera, a still background, a distant hero, a hero seen from behind, a held pose, slow motion, speech after 7.45
